title: Fall 2026 Software & Firmware Updates
excerpt: New releases of Adamson's software and firmware are available for download.

image.alt: Laptop running Adamson software in front of a mixing console

content:
New versions of ArrayIntelligence, Array Tools and the XG Series firmware are available today from Documentation & Downloads.

ArrayIntelligence 4.2 adds faster prediction for large Vergence systems and a new venue import. XG firmware 2.6 adds Milan redundancy and shortens boot time.

As always, updates are free for every Adamson owner.

title: Adamson Powers Historic Warsaw Theatre in Brooklyn
excerpt: The historic Warsaw theatre in Brooklyn now runs on an Adamson system.

image.alt: Ornate theatre ceiling with flown Adamson loudspeakers and lighting truss

content:
The Warsaw, a 1924 landmark in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, has reopened with a new Adamson system designed for its ornate ballroom.

The install pairs IS7 line arrays with IS119 subwoofers, flown to keep sightlines clear of the restored ceiling.

“The room finally sounds as good as it looks,” said the venue’s production manager.

title: D-Block Europe’s PTSD2 Arena Tour
excerpt: D-Block Europe take Adamson on the road for the PTSD2 arena tour.

image.alt: Arena crowd holding up phone lights under a loudspeaker array

content:
D-Block Europe’s PTSD2 arena tour runs on a Vergence Group system across 24 UK and European arenas.

The rig uses VGt main hangs, VGs subwoofers and XG amplification, designed in ArrayIntelligence.
